'''Shiden''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Shiden was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Master Shiden resided on the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order, where she traded specialty goods at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shiden was removed from the game in update 6.2 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''.<ref name="Patch notes 6.2">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1292020/game-update-6.2|text=Game Update 6.2}}</ref> She was later brought back to the game in update 7.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''.<ref name="Patch notes 7.1">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/08022022/game-update-7.1-digging-deeper|text=Game Update 7.1: Digging Deeper Patch Notes}}</ref>
